component.summary: Forge is an AI engineering studio for agentic coding, automation, browser verification, and design workflows.

description.p: Forge combines a familiar code editor with adaptive AI model routing, focused skill loading, coding agents, browser automation, codebase understanding, design tooling, and persistent Work Mode automations.
The interface is designed to keep project context visible while reducing unnecessary model context and token use.
